This issue is decided against the plaintiff and in favor of the defendant.
PRAYER (1) A decree of recovery of possession is passed in respect of complete plot/land ad-measuring 1278.62 yards situated in Khasra no. 394 in Revenue Estate of Village Chilla Gharoda Neem Ka Bangar,
Delhi (now property bearing no. 65A- 65B in the above village) in favour of the plaintiffs no. 1 to 10 and against the defendants, their officials and agents as per the site plan and after viewing the fencing.
(2) A decree of recovery of possession is passed in respect of complete plot ad-measuring 500 sq.
yards situated in Khasra no. 393 in Revenue Estate of Village Chilla Gharoda Neem Ka Bangar,
Delhi (now property bearing no. 65B in the above village) in favour of the plaintiff no.11 and against the defendants, their officials agents as per the site plan and after viewing the fencing.

their officials and agents thereby restraining them permanently from parting with or assigning and/or giving possession of the property above mentioned to any third person/agency.
